svg.title: CareerStudio
svg.desc: Source for logo.png. A white briefcase on a saturated indigo tile, rather than the site's flat black icon: clients that force-invert an email (the Gmail mobile apps, Chrome force dark) would turn a dark mark on transparency into an invisible one, while a saturated tile stays legible on any background. Regenerate the PNG (email clients cannot render SVG) with a headless browser screenshot of this file at 96x96 on a transparent canvas.
